answer: Pair identities at random each epoch to prove co-presence. Two keys from different shards get a joint nonce and must both answer within thirty seconds, each reply carrying the other's half signed over the shared thread. A farm cannot fake this: the exchange is bidirectional and halves validate only together, so one process answering both sides leaks its own key. Auditors replay four in ten pairs; a broken thread burns both bonds. Two hundred clones need two hundred live counterparts, a cost returning every epoch like a tide, while an honest agent spends one exchange at the forge.
